messages:
incident-bot: [P1] cont-batch latency spike detected on pool 'eu-west-1-cb' — sudden p95 jump and error-rate increase. Pager routed to @eng-oncall. Thread created for live mitigation.

Alex L: seeing queue growth + KV cache size spike. lots of inflight microbatches held open. this looks like a prefetch/regression.

Maya K: confirmed — kv_cache_items doubled over 3m, eviction thrash happening. queue length x6 across shards.

TJ: any customer-facing 5xx or timeouts yet?

Alex L: two dedicated customers reported 500s for ~10m (Acme Health), hosted route Searchly >2s tail. paused new canary traffic to affected model.

Rami S: scanning logs — prefetch loop repopulating KV aggressively when continuous_batch backlog grows. suspect recent heuristic change that increases prefetch parallelism under load.

Alex L: mitigation plan: reduce continuous-batch microbatch ceiling and disable prefetch for the pool. roll hotfix to a single shard, canary, then rollout.

Maya K: run via control-plane CLI, example: 
```
redwoodctl pool patch eu-west-1-cb --set cb.microbatch_max=2 --set prefetch.enabled=false
```

TJ: canary to one shard and route 1% traffic. I'll coordinate customer comms.

deploy-bot: deploy: patch submitted by Alex L. Rollout started at 1798012400 -> shard eu-west-1-cb-3.

Alex L: hotfix applied to shard-3. observing queue length drop 120 -> 30 within 90s, p95 latency down ~38%. eviction events ceased on that shard.

Maya K: good sign. still seeing intermittent microburst spikes — suggest adding small jitter smoothing to batching loop to prevent synchronized microbatches.

Rami S: proposing `batching.jitter_ms=5` and keep `cb.microbatch_max=2` for now. will monitor KV growth threshold alerts.

Alex L: note customer impact: Acme Health (dedicated) degraded throughput; Searchly (hosted) saw elevated tail latency. TJ to PM/SE for outreach.

TJ: pinged SEs and started customer update. will publish status page entry after stabilization.

Maya K: requesting 15m canary observe window before full rollout. if stable, proceed to remaining shards. also opening postmortem skeleton and tying to evals to prevent perf regressions.

Rami S: handing off monitoring to night oncall. Handoff notes: commands run, current flags: `cb.microbatch_max=2`, `prefetch=false`, `batching.jitter_ms=5`. TODOs: 1) root-cause diff for prefetch heuristic change; 2) add hard prefetch rate-limits; 3) automated rollback when kv_size growth >25% over 2m.

incident-bot: severity downgraded to P2 at 1798012550 — no new 5xx after hotfix, queue/backpressure subsiding.

TJ: thanks all — I’ll update customers and status page. :thumbsup:

Maya K: postmortem skeleton created -> https://redwood.internal/pm/1798012345

Alex L: leaving thread for follow-up, will add waveform graphs and knobs we changed. Good job team.
